lod_selection.lod0: Detailed blockout master for close review
lod_selection.lod1: Game candidate; engine-driven MOUNT_YAW and CRADLE_PITCH; canonical sentry rides the tilting cradle
lod_selection.lod2: Static opaque proxy; no interior or shell/cap hiding

runtime.sentry_attachment: Attach canonical sentry ROOT directly to CRADLE_PITCH with zero local translation/rotation; do not inherit socket orientation or add a second aiming rotation.

runtime.distance: Static parked mount; swap to LOD1 before driving pivots.
